scripts.deploy: PUBLIC_ORIGIN=https://chatwerk.esembe.app pnpm run build:production && pnpm exec wrangler d1 migrations apply chatwerk --remote && pnpm exec wrangler deploy
scripts.test:worker: pnpm run build && mkdir -p .wrangler/logs && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs/wrangler.log WRANGLER_REGISTRY_PATH=.wrangler/registry MINIFLARE_REGISTRY_PATH=$PWD/.wrangler/registry vitest run --config vitest.worker.config.ts
scripts.check: pnpm run build && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test && pnpm run test:worker
